results.title: Fairey Albacore (1940)
results.body: By February 1940, The Albacore was fitted with the Taurus II and started flights at RAF Boscombe Down. This enabled the Albacor to reach speeds in excess of 160 mph (140 kn; 260 km/h) at 4,800 ft (1,463 m) and loaded at 11,570 lb (5,259 kg), the payload tested being four depth charges underwings.

results.title: Fairey Albacore - Classic Warbirds
results.body: The Albacore Mk I was powered by the 1,130-hp Bristol Taurus XII engine, its top speed was 161 mph, range 930 miles, with a service ceiling of 20,700 ft. Armament was either two or three 0.303-in machine-guns, one forward-firing and one or two rear-firing. Bomb load was either 2,000lb bombs or torpedoes.
